title: Black Book: Untold Legends
description: Read the Black Book Untold Legends in Benkongerike Great Hall and navigate through Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha to learn its hidden knowledge and choose one of three rewards: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.

base_facts: The Black Book Untold Legends is found in Benkongerike Great Hall.
Reading it transports the reader to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha.
It grants one of three lesser powers: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.

ENTERED_APOCRYPHA: The reader has been transported to Apocrypha and must uncover the hidden knowledge.
COMPLETED_QUEST: The hidden knowledge has been learned and a reward power chosen.
Player learned the hidden knowledge and chose a reward. Quest is complete.
Once any side areas have been dealt with, the corridor should return to its original position, leading to the Black Book : Untold Legends .
Detailed Walkthrough [ edit ] There are five chapters: Chapter I is basically a corridor that leads to Chapter II, containing no enemies and only three soul gems in the way of loot.

base_facts: A Dremora merchant can be summoned using the Black Market power to trade items for 15 seconds.
A Dremora butler can be summoned using the Secret Servant power to carry up to 148 weight in items for 15 seconds.
